description: Two-party escrow with a thread token: one script with a minting and a spending purpose

measurements.name: deposit_successful
measurements.description: Deposit: the buyer mints the thread token into a new escrow UTXO with 75 ADA

measurements.name: accept_successful
measurements.description: Accept: the seller spends the escrow UTXO, burns the token and receives 75 ADA

measurements.name: accept_burn
measurements.description: Accept, minting side: the same transaction burns the thread token

measurements.name: refund_successful
measurements.description: Refund: after the deadline the buyer spends the escrow UTXO, burns the token and receives 75 ADA

measurements.name: refund_burn
measurements.description: Refund, minting side: the same transaction burns the thread token

checks.name: deposit_without_buyer_signature
checks.description: Deposit with no required signer must fail (rule D1)

checks.name: deposit_signed_by_seller_only
checks.description: Deposit signed by the seller instead of the buyer must fail (rule D1)

checks.name: deposit_with_second_signature
checks.description: Deposit with a second required signer next to the buyer succeeds

checks.name: deposit_infinite_upper_bound
checks.description: Deposit with no upper bound on the validity range must fail: there is no deposit time to record (rule D2)

checks.name: deposit_infinite_lower_bound
checks.description: Deposit with no lower bound on the validity range succeeds: only the upper bound is read

checks.name: deposit_mints_two_tokens
checks.description: Deposit that mints two thread tokens, one of them into the buyer's change, must fail (rule D3)

checks.name: deposit_mints_second_token_name

checks.name: deposit_mints_wrong_token_name
checks.description: Deposit that mints a token with another name instead of the thread token must fail (rules D3, D6)

checks.name: deposit_with_unrelated_mint
checks.description: Deposit next to mints of two other policies, one sorting before the escrow policy and one after, succeeds

checks.name: deposit_to_pubkey_address
checks.description: Deposit whose 75 ADA, token and datum go to a public key address must fail (rule D4)

checks.name: deposit_to_other_script
checks.description: Deposit whose escrow output sits at another script must fail: the address must come from the policy id (rule D4)

checks.name: deposit_with_second_script_output

checks.name: deposit_with_second_script_output_staked
checks.description: Deposit with a second output at the escrow script under another staking credential must fail: outputs are counted by payment credential (rule D4)

checks.name: deposit_split_across_script_outputs
